steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for hobbies and interests. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons. | French Exam Tips — Hobbies and Interests: 1. For Hobbies and Interests, use a range of vocabulary and complex grammatical structures to access higher marks 2. Check verb tenses, agreements and word order carefully in your written work 3. In translation tasks, translate meaning rather than word-for-word 4. When writing about Hobbies and Interests, include opinions and justifications, not just descriptions 5. For listening and reading, focus on key words and cognates to extract meaning

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write 4 sentences in French about hobbies and interests. | Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on hobbies and interests. | Translate into French: "I think hobbies and interests is important because..."
